Prices are ex-showroom (Delhi unless stated) from the Sept 2025 post-GST list and Autocar India / CarWale model pages; they change by city and month. Specs, colours and variants are taken from official Maruti Suzuki and Tata Motors brochures; Maruti mileage is ARAI-certified per its brochures, while Tata brochures do not publish mileage so power and torque are shown instead. Tata prices: CarDekho (Sept 2026); Aeris and Xpres show launch / introductory prices. Safety ratings come from public NCAP reports, not the brochures.
